core_obligations: Reduce the first assertion to a vanishing (proof lines 3052-3082): for a normal modification of the spectrum of the completion one has to show that the first cohomology of the structure sheaf vanishes; such a modification is an isomorphism over the punctured spectrum, so it is dominated by an admissible blowup, and the descent lemma provides an admissible blowup over the original ring whose base change dominates it; replacing that blowup by its normalization (which is legitimate as the ring is Nagata) gives a normal modification of the original spectrum, whose first cohomology vanishes by the rationality assumption; flat base change transfers the vanishing to the base change, and the exact sequence then gives the vanishing for the given modification.

Prepare the second assertion (proof lines 3084-3096): the base change of the blowup of the maximal ideal is the blowup of the maximal ideal of the completion, and both are normal by the normality lemma for blowups of rational singularities; since the completion is excellent, every affine open of the blowup has an excellent normal coordinate ring, so the completion map at each point is regular and therefore the completed local rings stay normal.

Conclude (proof lines 3096-3100): for a closed point of the special fibre there is a unique closed point of the base change above it, and the local rings at these two points have isomorphic completions, so the normality of the completed local ring of the base change gives the normality of the completion of the local ring of the blowup at the chosen point.
proof_roadmap: Translate the rationality of the completion into a vanishing statement for modifications and dominate such a modification by an admissible blowup descended from the original ring.
Normalize that blowup to obtain a normal modification of the original spectrum and transfer the vanishing along the completion by flat base change.
For the blowup of the maximal ideal, use normality of the blowups, excellency of the completion and the isomorphism of completions at the relevant points.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a two dimensional Nagata local normal domain defining a rational singularity with normal completion, the completion again defines a rational singularity and the completions of the local rings of the blowup of the maximal ideal at closed points are normal (statement lines 3052-3062). The proof (proof lines 3064-3110) turns the first assertion into a vanishing statement, spreads modifications from the completion to the original ring, transfers the vanishing by flat base change, and obtains the second assertion from normality of the blowups, excellency of the completion and an isomorphism of completions. H3: two assertions with several transfers of properties, written out in full.
